segments.summary: Reviewed the complete prologue, feature-family source summaries, owner/consumer map, and FL-002 through FL-004 under exact and adversarial lenses; reference authority and owner deferrals are explicit.

Reviewed every line of FL-005 through FL-011, including debug lifecycle, architecture authority, Assistant consumer boundaries, native review UX, shell composition, routing primitives, and delegation lineage.

Reviewed every line of FL-012 through FL-018 across runtime records, visible explanations, scheduler/storage alignment, worktree lineage, rendering surfaces and trust, and coordinated operational-panel scope; found an explanation-oracle gap.

Reviewed every line of FL-019 through FL-024; identified an undefined Kubernetes scope boundary, a high-confidence GUI classification conflict in FL-021, and unresolved multi-repo/artifact-oracle discretion.

Reviewed FL-025, retired FL-001, Migration Coverage, and both FABLE addenda; owner alignment and retirement are explicit, and the remaining FABLE row is visibly deferred without buildability or runtime-proof claims.
